prompt: Recompose existing volcanic fan art as a wide 2:1 hero banner. Preserve official Zakum face stack, golden semicircular crown/crest, carved hands and tablet. Boss on right half with crown/top face and raised hands fully visible; quieter dark volcanic cavern on left for rate text. Lava, chains, platforms and a few decorative coins/scrolls. Full bleed to every edge; no UI, text, borders, black bars, logos or damage numbers. Match classic MapleStory 2D painted/pixel art, charcoal and muted orange.
